tools.description: How the site did over a period compared with the one before it: clicks, impressions, CTR, average position and the change in each. Covers the question 'how is my site doing'.

days.description: Length of the window, counted back from the last day with data. Default 28.

end_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to the last day with data.

site.description: Search Console property, exactly as list_sites reports it (sc-domain:example.com or https://example.com/). Optional when the account has only one property.
